name: Blaster
doc: Blaster (enemy attacks 122 / 123, Torama's): the charge's beams and rings between two points of the caster, a red screen fade, bolts from its mouth to the target flickering through four key meshes and their in-betweens, sparks at the mouth and the target, a glow at the mouth, a shock wave at the target shaking it, splashes; the screen flash; the sound; the damage at tick 60. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag186_blaster.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particles, aim, bolt in-between meshes and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The director's ticks: each part's start, the sound, the damage, the end; the mouth point and the aim (every tick), the screen flash; the bolt's in-between meshes (tick 0); the charge's beams and rings; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Screen fade
parts.doc: A red full-screen fade: up, held, down (its colour v, v / 4, v / 4)

parts.title: Charge beams
parts.doc: Beams between two of the caster's points, each with a ring fading over its second half, at the boundaries of the exe's interval table

parts.title: Bolts
parts.doc: Bolt meshes from the mouth to the target, flickering through their key and in-between meshes, turning, fading over their last ticks

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Still sparks at the mouth and at the target, each playing its flipbook once

parts.title: Glow
parts.doc: A glow flipbook at the mouth, dimming at the end

parts.title: Shock wave
parts.doc: A shock wave mesh at the target, its texture cycling, fading at the end; the target shaken

parts.title: Splashes
parts.doc: Splashes thrown out from the target along the aim, slowing

groups.label: Screen flash
groups.doc: Up by 128 a tick until tick up, down from tick down to 0 at the end
